The '''rug-cleaning droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that cleaned rugs. Popular in the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large, it however, resembled the [[Repulsorlift personal jump pack]] from [[Exocron]].
